name: @devhq/models
description: DevHQ ML service (Python 3.12, FastAPI). npm scripts are thin wrappers over uv so `npm test --workspaces` covers it; the Python toolchain is the source of truth.

scripts.train: uv run --frozen devhq-models train --model all --source synthetic
scripts.train:backend: uv run --frozen devhq-models train --model all --source backend
scripts.lint: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --frozen ruff check --fix . && uv run --frozen ruff format .
scripts.lock: uv lock && uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt -o requirements.lock
